footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. From pre-tax income to net loss to common: includes a $21.0M income tax benefit; after income tax and $33.0M of preferred dividends & other. Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) fell 19.2% to $2.1B in 2025. Net interest income fell 20.0% to $1.7B and noninterest income fell 14.7% to $341M; noninterest expense fell 26.8%, and the provision for credit losses was $184M, versus $1.1B.
Net loss to common was −$210M, versus −$1.2B, or −$0.50 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 100.7% versus 111.2%. Flagstar returned $15.0M through dividends.
highlights: Net loss to common was −$210M, versus −$1.2B.
